shared_tail.surface: أبي بكر بن عمارة بن رؤيبة

notes: «جميعا عن وكيع» converges three routes on Waki: three groups and one shared tail (rule 3)
«قال أبو كريب حدثنا وكيع» repeats the same shaykh: one link (rule 7)
The Basra man's question and the father's «نعم» are the story's scene; the father is already the last link (rule 6)
«- يعني ...»-style glosses: none; the editor's remark at the end is not chain
